'''Hannah Mira Cairo''' (born 2007) is an American mathematician who gained recognition at age 17 for disproving the longstanding [[Mizohata–Takeuchi conjecture]] in [[harmonic analysis]].

== Early life and education ==
Cairo was born in [[Nassau, Bahamas]].<ref name="DerStandard">{{cite news |last1=Kleindl |first1=Reinhard |title=17-jährige Schülerin löst ein jahrzehntealtes Mathematikproblem |trans-title=17-year-old student solves a decades-old math problem |url=https://www.derstandard.at/story/3000000277869/17-jaehrige-schuelerin-loest-ein-jahrzehntealtes-mathematikproblem |access-date=12 July 2025 |work=Der Standard |date=4 July 2025 |language=German |archive-date=8 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250708142048/https://www.derstandard.at/story/3000000277869/17-jaehrige-schuelerin-loest-ein-jahrzehntealtes-mathematikproblem |url-status=live }}</ref> She is [[transgender]].<ref name="SciAm">{{cite web |last1=Hasson |first1=Emma R. |title=Teen Hannah Cairo's Mathematical Discovery Sends Ripples through Harmonic Analysis |url=https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/how-teen-mathematician-hannah-cairo-disproved-a-major-conjecture-in-harmonic/ |website=Scientific American |access-date=6 August 2025 |language=en |date=4 August 2025}}</ref> She began studying mathematics using online lessons from [[Khan Academy]], and finished calculus by age 11.<ref name=quanta/> During the COVID-19 pandemic, she began participating in the Berkeley [[Math Circle]] (BMC) remotely.<ref name="elpais">{{cite news |last1=Timón |first1=Ágata A |title=A 17-year-old teen refutes a mathematical conjecture proposed 40 years ago |url=https://english.elpais.com/science-tech/2025-07-01/a-17-year-old-teen-refutes-a-mathematical-conjecture-proposed-40-years-ago.html |access-date=12 July 2025 |work=El País |date=1 July 2025 |id={{ProQuest|3226530728}} |archive-date=12 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250712003951/https://english.elpais.com/science-tech/2025-07-01/a-17-year-old-teen-refutes-a-mathematical-conjecture-proposed-40-years-ago.html |url-status=live }}</ref> After moving to the United States, she continued to attend university-level mathematics lectures at the [[University of California, Berkeley]], including courses taught by mathematician [[Ruixiang Zhang]].<ref name="DerStandard" />

In fall 2025, having skipped the standard bachelor's and master's degrees, began her PhD studies at the [[University of Maryland]],<ref name=elpais /> focusing on Fourier restriction theory.<ref name="SciAm" />

== Mathematical work ==
While studying under Zhang, Cairo began working on the [[Mizohata–Takeuchi conjecture]], which had remained unresolved since the 1980s.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nguyen |first=Lisa |date=29 July 2025 |title=Mizohata-Takeuchi-Vermutung: 17-jährige Schülerin löst ein jahrzehntealtes Mathe-Problem  |trans-title=Mizohata-Takeuchi conjecture: 17-year-old student solves a decades-old math problem |url=https://www.tagesanzeiger.ch/hannah-cairo-17-jaehrige-schuelerin-loest-mathe-problem-419992850915 |access-date=2 August 2025 |website=Tages-Anzeiger |language=de}}</ref> Initially aiming to prove the conjecture, she instead constructed a counterexample that disproved it.<ref name=elpais /> Her work involved using fractals and other tools and originally resulted in a more complex counterexample before finding a simpler example after reformulating the problem in frequency space.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Shavit |first=Joshua |date=12 July 2025 |title=Teen stuns math community by disproving widely accepted 40-year-old math conjecture |url=https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/teen-stuns-math-community-disproving-000700158.html |access-date=1 August 2025 |website=AOL Today}}</ref>

Her findings were published in the preprint titled "A Counterexample to the Mizohata–Takeuchi Conjecture" and uploaded to the arXiv preprint server on February 10, 2025.<ref>{{harvnb|Cairo|2025}}</ref> Later that year, she presented her work at the 12th International Congress on Harmonic Analysis and Partial Differential Equations in [[El Escorial, Madrid|El Escorial]], Spain.<ref name=elpais /> Media described her as one of the youngest mathematicians to resolve a major open problem.<ref name="DerStandard" /><ref name="elpais" /><ref>{{Cite news |last1=Schulz |first1=Adrian |last2=Önal |first2=Özben |date=17 July 2025 |title=17-Jährige löste jahrzehntealtes Rätsel: "Manchmal lege ich mich früher ins Bett, um über Mathe nachzudenken"  |trans-title=17-year-old solves decades-old puzzle: "Sometimes I go to bed early to think about math" |url=https://www.tagesspiegel.de/wissen/17-jahrige-loste-jahrzehntealtes-ratsel-manchmal-lege-ich-mich-fruher-ins-bett-um-uber-mathe-nachzudenken-14003789.html |access-date=17 July 2025 |work=Der Tagesspiegel Online |language=de-DE |issn=1865-2263}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Bischoff |first=Manon |date=16 July 2025 |title=Harmonische Analysis: 17-Jährige widerlegt jahrzehntealte Mathematik-Vermutung |trans-title=Harmonic Analysis: 17-year-old refutes decades-old mathematical conjecture |url=https://www.spektrum.de/news/mathematik-hannah-cairo-widerlegt-mizohata-takeuchi-vermutung/2277669 |access-date=17 July 2025 |website=Spektrum.de |language=de}}</ref><ref name=quanta>{{Cite web |last=Hartnett |first=Kevin |date=1 August 2025 |title=At 17, Hannah Cairo Solved a Major Math Mystery |url=https://www.quantamagazine.org/at-17-hannah-cairo-solved-a-major-math-mystery-20250801/ |access-date=1 August 2025 |website=[[Quanta Magazine]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite arXiv |last1=Cairo |first1=Hannah |title=Power loss for the Mizohata-Takeuchi conjecture on $C^k$ convex hypersurfaces |date=2025-12-08 |eprint=2512.08064 |last2=Zhang |first2=Ruixiang |class=math.CA }}</ref>
